cases.name: Dynamic Layer or Table resource
cases.notes: Returns layer metadata for source.type=mapLayer and allowlisted source.type=dataLayer workspace definitions, including request-scoped id, definitionExpression, and drawingInfo. A dataLayer source resolves a registered workspace (dataSource.workspaceId) and table (dataSource.dataSourceName) to a published resource on that workspace, gated by GeoServices:MapServer:DynamicLayers (WorkspaceLayersEnabled + allowlist). Joins and dynamic query tables remain deferred.

cases.name: Estimate Export Tile Size
cases.notes: Estimates bounded WebMercatorQuad tile archive size; reports tilePackage/storageFormat for both ZIP and Esri exploded-cache TPK (storageFormat=tpk).

cases.name: Export Tiles
cases.notes: Exports bounded WebMercatorQuad PNG tiles to configured cloud file storage. storageFormat=zip (default) writes a flat {z}/{x}/{y}.png ZIP and storageFormat=tpk (or tilePackage=true) writes an Esri exploded-cache TPK (v101/<cache>/_alllayers + conf.xml/conf.cdi); both are synchronous. Compact Cache V2 / TPKX (storageFormatType=esriMapCacheStorageModeCompactV2, or storageFormat=tpkx/compact/compactv2) submits a durable asynchronous job and returns the ArcGIS { jobId, jobStatus } envelope; the package is a real Esri TPKX 1.0 archive of Compact Cache V2 .bundle files. It requires the durable tile-export job runtime (an execution job store); when that is unavailable the request is rejected rather than silently downgraded. Partial because the export stays bounded to WebMercatorQuad and gdbVersion-style parameters are ignored.
